description: Jekyll personal site for jmhung.com, deployed to GitHub Pages

features.name: Clean Jekyll Build
features.description: Site builds with strict front matter and produces all expected output files
features.evidence: bash init.sh exits 0: jekyll 4.4.1 build --strict_front_matter succeeds, all six expected _site/ artifacts present, 1/1 posts built, all root-relative links resolve

features.name: Home Page
features.description: Root page renders through the default layout with title and description metadata
features.evidence:
Builds and renders (_site/index.html has Home · Jimmy Hung), but body copy is unfinished: two PLACEHOLDER comments remain, and index.html:10 has a stray closing

with a missing opening

features.name: Deepdive Index
features.description: Post index lists every published post newest-first, with an empty state when none exist
features.evidence: _site/deepdive.html links href="/deepdive/jcode-deepdive-example/"; empty-state branch present in deepdive.html source but not exercised while posts exist

features.name: Post Layout & Permalinks
features.description: Posts render via post.html with title and date, published under /deepdive/:title/, code blocks highlighted
features.evidence: _site/deepdive/jcode-deepdive-example/index.html built from _posts/2026-07-09-*.md, title 'jcode Deepdive: Example (delete me) · Jimmy Hung', rouge emitted a class="highlight" block for the js fence

features.name: Navigation Active State
features.description: Primary nav marks the current section with aria-current, including posts under Deepdive
features.evidence: _site/index.html renders <a href="/" aria-current="page">; the Deepdive link carries the same condition for page.layout == 'post'

features.name: Light/Dark Theme Toggle
features.description: Theme follows OS preference, can be overridden by the toggle, persists in localStorage, and applies before first paint
features.evidence: Code is in place and ships to _site/ (css/style.css defines data-theme overrides, js/theme.js and the pre-paint inline script are present), but not yet verified in a browser in both themes

features.name: Custom Domain
features.description: Site serves from jmhung.com with CNAME preserved through the build
features.evidence: CNAME contains jmhung.com and is copied to _site/CNAME by the build; matches url in _config.yml

features.name: GitHub Pages Deployment
features.description: Push to main builds via actions/jekyll-build-pages and deploys to GitHub Pages
features.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml is configured for push to main with pages/id-token permissions; no run observed from this working tree
